board "Event Replay: where the example runs in code"
group web "web"
group main "api main service"
group events "api events service"
node page globe "Event page" in web "EventDetail.jsx"
node btn user "Replay button" in web
node api api "Replay API call" in web "eventsApi.js"
node ctrl server "Replay controller" in main "controllers/v2/events.py"
node svc box "Event service" in main
node db database "Postgres" in main
node task zap "Celery task" in main
node ingest server "Ingest endpoint" in events
node proc cpu "Event processor" in events
node rules list "Rule engine" in events
node store database "Events DB" in events
edge page -> btn
edge btn -> api
edge api -> ctrl "POST /replay"
edge ctrl -> svc
edge svc -> db
edge svc -> task
edge task -> ingest "replay"
edge ingest -> proc
edge proc -> rules
edge rules -> store
